mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions and a mild 70 degrees near Verona Community Park. Tonight at 5:50 PM, skywatchers can spot the International Space Station passing overhead for three minutes, rising northwest near Verona High School and moving low near the horizon toward Fitchburg.

In city news, property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th. Payments can be made in two installments, with the first due January 31st to the City Treasurer and the second due July 31st. Options to pay include mail, online, or using the 24/7 drop box at City Center. Also, remember that lottery credit applications must be submitted by January 30th.
For local events, Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at several locations, including Hop Haus Brewing Company, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.

In this week's police recap, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on East Verona Avenue where a 34-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I while traveling with a child.
To finish off, Culvers is open until 10:00 PM tonight, with Butter Pecan featured as the flavor of the day.
